title: Don't delay ascending volume alerts by 3 minutes
symptom: The ascending volume profile starts at silent, causing a 3-minute delay before any audible alert, which may result in missing alerts or glucose levels changing before the alarm is heard.
cause: The AlertPlayer.java file has an if statement on line 530 that keeps the alert silent for 3 minutes for the ascending profile only, during which only the vibrate option functions.
fix: The thread proposes changing the ascending volume profile to start from a very low volume instead of silent, and suggests making medium, high, and ascending volume profiles have no delay. However, no code change is confirmed as implemented.
evidence_quote: The _if_ statement on line 530 keeps the alert (for ascending profile only) silent for 3 minutes. Only the vibrate option will function in that period.
